description: This file defines the "QualificationsMenuConfigurator" class, which implements menu configuration logic within the OrangeHRM system's admin module. It uses traits and interfaces to modify screen behavior associated with qualifications menu items.

classes.name: QualificationsMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for qualifications in the admin module, adjusting screen URLs.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen URL by replacing 'save' with 'view' in the current action URL, to modify menu behavior.
